questions.skill: Read values of an inverse function
questions.standard_level: Precalculus. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Precalculus, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: The function f has domain {1, 2, 3, 4}, with f(1) = 3, f(2) = 5, f(3) = 7, and f(4) = 9. Its outputs are all different, so f has an inverse. Find f⁻¹(7).
questions.prompt_markup:
The function f has domain {1, 2, 3, 4}, with f(1) = 3, f(2) = 5, f(3) = 7, and f(4) = 9. Its outputs are all different, so f has an inverse.
Find f⁻¹(7).
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent form. f(3) = 7, so f⁻¹(7) = 3.
